args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money's docstring says it uses banker's rounding, but the
implementation passed ROUND_HALF_UP to quantize(). This broke
tests/test_money.py: 2.665 rounds to 2.67 instead of 2.66.

Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to the
nearest even cent, per FIN-212.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money()` in `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in its call to `quantize()`.
- This caused the nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py` expects `2.665 -> 2.66` (round-half-to-even), but `ROUND_HALF_UP` produced `2.67`.
- Fix: switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Tests
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (includes tests/test_money.py).

This needs to ship in today's release, so please review/merge promptly. Thanks!
